snippet.title: Found in 2 Tries ⚖️ Riddle #11 Answer + Riddle #12: The Snail in the Well 🐌 #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's mystery: 8 balls, 1 a bit heavier, and only 2 tries on the scale.

ANSWER: Put 3 balls on each side and keep 2 off. If the scale stays level, the heavy ball is one of the 2 left over: weigh them 1 against 1. If one side goes down, take those 3 and weigh 1 against 1. If that is level, it is the third ball. Found in just 2 tries!

RIDDLE #12: Person 1 finds a snail at the bottom of a well, 10 metres deep. Every day the snail climbs up 3 metres. Every night, while it sleeps, it slides back down 2 metres. On which day does the snail finally get out of the well?

Comment your answer 👇 The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
